Elena — quick answers before the call:

1) Disputes: We can pause a sweep and hold the credits on your ledger balance. The formal dispute resolution is joint: Acme flags the milestone with product evidence and we triage with Customer Success. If unresolved after 14 days we escalate to legal. We document the hold on the ledger and produce a "sweep hold" memo for audit.

2) VAT flow: If Acme provides valid EU VAT registration and a self-assessment (reverse charge), Redwood will issue net invoices with a clear note on reverse charge. We include VAT id and annotation fields in the invoice PDF so your accounting team can file. If reverse-charge evidence is missing at time of invoice we will apply VAT and then issue a corrective credit once evidence is provided.

3) PO timing: one week prior is fine; three business days is our minimum to guarantee invoice-number alignment. If you provide earlier, even better.

I'll upload a short checklist for AP to the Drive link and bring a template to the call. Meeting invite to follow.

Best,
